stage2_audit: Reviewed immutable font/path capture, safe diagnostics, workspace admission before decode, cancellation and shared stroke opacity. No additional runtime corrections required after the passing focused suite. Final full gate verified matching source.
stage3_animation_audit: PNG chunk names and reserved bits reject malformed containers before decoding.
Animated GIF uses exact palettes where possible and keeps white in the fallback palette.
Regression coverage proves retained animation memory admission, opaque GIF backgrounds and persisted animation colors.
avif_audit: Private inspection retains codec admission details without changing the public Info struct layout; shared decode/plan/layer/animation paths use the same workspace calculation.
AVIF item extents, metadata entries, sample/timing tables, grid dimensions and low-overhead OBU framing are bounded before invoking the codec. Decoder frame area is explicitly capped.

Resource admission counts every frame unit against the largest permitted coded frame area, plus grids, alpha, metadata and gathered bytes; validates decoded sequence dimensions, sample counts and exact rational timeline.
DecodeAll silently falls back to a still on sequence errors; wrapper rejects fallback including one-frame sequences by requiring positive declared timing. AVIF output remains still-only.
No public owner/signature additions in the AVIF slice; existing plans, capabilities and attachment variant APIs are exercised by independent consumer and PostgreSQL tests.
Inspected new files for duplicate ownership and naming; container, item metadata, sample tables and decoding live in separate focused private files. Runtime codecs remain existing dependencies.
stage3_encoding_audit: Encoder dispatch moved into encoding.go; static PNG and APNG share one compression option owner.
Explicit zero AVIF speed and PNG default compression use existing value.Optional, preserving omission semantics and independent plan values.
Format-specific controls require the intended explicit format and validate at declaration time; independent compile-fail rejects a Resampling value used as PNGCompression.
Corrected maximum-quality AVIF documentation: codec still converts RGB and subsamples 4:2:0; lowest quantizer does not imply an exact RGB round trip.

Existing nativewebp encoder ignores io.Writer errors. boundedOutput now retains its first failure; static and animation publication inspect that failure even if a codec returns nil. All eight output codecs must return no Result when output exceeds its cap.

Existing nativewebp also offers lossless animation encoding, and x/image/webp can decode individual VP8/VP8L frames. A bounded RIFF compositor/writer can add portable animation without installing dependencies; lossy output still needs the pending replacement approval. Avoid EncodeAll directly: it gathers all frame payloads and does not expose frame source-replacement blending.

Reading x/image/webp showed DecodeConfig returns the VP8X canvas without checking VP8/VP8L coded dimensions. Added direct bounded coded-header inspection before pixel allocation, rejecting mismatches/duplicate still image chunks; regressions exercise both coded formats and a real extended lossless round trip.

webp_followup_notes.independent_fixtures: /private/tmp/foundry-webp-fixtures: synthetic 16x12 four-frame lossless/lossy WebP files generated with existing bundled Pillow/libwebp; source PNG canvases retained. Durations 30/70/110/130 ms, loop 2; nonzero offsets, both blend flags and disposal-to-background exercised.
webp_followup_notes.decoder_boundary: x/image/webp rejects valid extended VP8L+alpha; decode validated VP8L payloads directly in the new container/frame path. VP8 with ALPH still needs its correctly sized VP8X wrapper. Keep raw coded-dimension checks before decoding.
webp_followup_notes.encoder_boundary: Use bounded per-frame encoding and write RIFF/ANMF explicitly with full-canvas source replacement. nativewebp.EncodeAll buffers all frames and lacks a public source-replacement blend option.
webp_followup_notes.timing_followup: Reduce out-of-range rational delays before deciding APNG cannot represent an AVIF timeline (for example 100000/1000000 seconds is 1/10).

stage3_webp_audit: No new dependency. All WebP admission and decoding share one bounded container owner; both static and animation coded dimensions are checked before decoding. Input slices are borrowed for the synchronous operation.

Frames include offsets, overwrite/over blending, background disposal, durations and total plays. FirstFrame renders only its selected frame onto the logical canvas. Output uses full replacement canvases, including transparency.

Output uses bounded per-frame encoding and streaming RIFF assembly rather than the dependency EncodeAll buffer. Sticky writer failures prevent publishing partial files. Unrepresentable loop counts/durations/output dimensions reject.

Independent decoding exposed an existing static-codec color issue: VP8 video-range samples passed through Go image.YCbCr full-range conversion. The shared WebP path now performs BT.601 range/matrix conversion with centered bilinear chroma interpolation. Both static and animation regressions cover it; this does not claim ICC color management.

Source inspection and allocation sampling found fixed lossless-encoder hash tables. Admission now reserves 4 MiB in addition to pixel-dependent workspace. VP8 decode admission includes padded macroblocks, even on narrow images.
Shared integer delay rounding preserves millisecond/centisecond timing; APNG reduces high-frequency fractions before its 16-bit representability check.

Independent Pillow/libwebp 1.6.0 decoding verifies every output WebP/APNG frame, alpha, timing and loops. Final lossless and lossy RGB are exact on these synthetic fixtures (maximum visible channel difference 0); regression allows 3 for decoder rounding and makes no general bit-exact lossy claim. Invisible RGB is not compared.
Consumer plans use public Foundry types only. PostgreSQL variants now exercise both animated PNG and WebP persistence/readback.
configured_image_consumer_review: Updated the existing configured HTTP fixture instead of introducing another engine factory or duplicate service API. The guide now leads with application.New, Image.Enabled and Services.Image; standalone New/Module remain documented. Final expansion acceptance still requires lossy WebP/native completion. Final expansion acceptance now also covers native application ownership, upload dimensions and attachment variants.
